name: Capsule Bag Dispenser
summary: Wall-mounted dog waste bag dispenser: a hinged capsule that closes with a single threaded screw, sized for a Ø40 × 70mm roll.
footerNote: Modeled in build123d/cadgen · PETG recommended for the front (hinge + latch) half, PLA fine for the back and pin.

parts.name: Closed assembly
parts.description: All four parts in their latched, wall-mounted position.

parts.name: Canister back
parts.description: Wall-mount half. Two screw holes at the apex, counterbored inside.
details: 3 full-round hinge knuckles, pivot offset from the parting edge by the pin radius
Plain clearance bore through the wall at the closing edge -- the closing screw's smooth tip rests here, unfastened

parts.name: Canister front
parts.description: Hinges open on a pivot offset from the parting edge, latches shut with a single threaded screw. Dispensing slit for pulling bags.
details: 3 full-round hinge knuckles, filleted into the OD on their near side
Tab resting against back's own wall, with a genuinely threaded screw fastening hole (cut by an oversized thread-maker, not a self-tapping pilot hole)

parts.name: Hinge pin
parts.description: 3mm rod through the interleaved knuckle row, on a pivot offset from the parting edge by the pin bore radius. A retention flange near one end catches against the first knuckle, so the pin can't be pushed or shaken all the way through and out the far side.
details: Ø5 x 1mm retention flange near the bottom end -- slides in from the open (headless) end

parts.name: Closing screw
parts.description: The whole latch: threads into the tab's genuinely threaded screw fastening hole (rigid with front), while its smooth tip rests with clearance inside a plain bore through back's own wall -- not fastened there at all. Front's latch edge opens by rotating about the far hinge, so its motion here is mostly tangential, not a straight pull; the bore's own side wall blocks that tangential slide, acting like a dowel pin spanning the joint.
details: Real printable helical thread, 2mm pitch, trapezoidal flat-crest profile
Smooth tip seats with clearance in back's plain wall bore
Turns into the tab's own real internal thread -- a true clearance fit, not self-tapping
